description: the woman of the reference picture riding: a dark reaper lady who gathers souls, a lean feminine figure in a hood of black smoke, a few strands of dark red-brown hair, the face hidden behind a silver mask shaped like a skull with glowing crimson eyes, armour of white bone like ribs over black shadow, spiked bone pauldrons, a long tattered black cloak hanging behind from the shoulders, a few pale white spirit lights streaming close behind the back like small wings, black boots with bone plates, no scythes and nothing in the hands but the reins; sitting tall and upright astride a saddle that is not drawn, the back straight, not squatting and not crouching, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing right, the head, chest and hips turned fully to the right; both forearms reaching forward, the two hands together in front of the body holding short reins that end just in front of the hands; only the near leg showing and only one foot in the whole picture: the thigh lying forward and level from the hip to the knee, the knee bent at a right angle, the lower leg hanging vertically straight down from the knee, one whole foot at the bottom with the toes pointing right; the folded wings, the cloak and any long hair close behind the back, not spread out; the far leg completely hidden and not drawn at all, no second boot and no second foot; the whole figure from the top of the hood and the spirit lights to the sole of the foot inside the picture with room around it; nothing under the rider; isolated figure on a plain background

references.usage: the character's look: this same woman, her skull mask, smoke hood, hair, bone armour, cloak, spirit lights and colours, drawn the same way; not her standing pose and not the two scythes
